notes: NNS-python consumes accepted NNS-core snapshots for native code and verifies public Python behavior against live or cached R NNS. r_commit/r_version record the R 13.3 commit (82a92eb) whose behavior the parity cache encodes. core_commit is the vendored NNS-core snapshot (extern/NNS-core = CMakeLists.txt, include/, src/ of that commit); it ports the R 13.3 src tree (NNS-core sync/nns_r_source.json) plus the R bug fixes listed there (CORE-01, -07, -08, -12, -13, -16). The vendored R snapshot (tools/NNS, r_src_tree_hash, tarball) is still the 13.0 tree; re-syncing it is a separate R snapshot update.
